title: Manual backup advice drops the encryption key and media folders
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:264 'Copying DATA_DIR/storage (or the whole DATA_DIR) still works...'; :252-262 lists 'gallery (generated/uploaded images and videos)' among file-store contents
reality: docs/data/where-data-is-stored.md:17-45: storage/ holds only text tables. Media lives in sibling DATA_DIR folders: avatars, sprites, backgrounds, gallery, fonts, knowledge-sources, game-assets, custom-emojis and custom-stickers. Saved API keys are encrypted with DATA_DIR/.encryption-key (code: packages/server/src/utils/crypto.ts:56, AES-256-GCM), unless ENCRYPTION_KEY is set. Copying only storage/ therefore loses media and leaves the keys undecryptable. CONFIGURATION.md:26 puts packages in DATA_DIR/capability-packages. docs/data/backup-and-restore.md:107-121: Export Profile strips API keys and webhook URLs; a full backup ZIP contains the key file and must stay private; restore is Settings > Imports > Profile & Marinara > Import Profile (JSON/ZIP), after which keys must be re-entered.
fix: architecture.md:264: drop 'DATA_DIR/storage (or'. Say: copy the whole DATA_DIR, including .encryption-key and the media and capability-packages folders, or use Download Backup / automatic backups. storage/ alone loses media and makes saved API keys unreadable. Add: Export Profile strips keys and webhook URLs, so re-enter them after Import Profile (Settings -> Imports). In :262, note that gallery files live in DATA_DIR/gallery, not the JSON store.

title: Semantic memory / lorebook embeddings described as local-only MiniLM
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:310 'Semantic memory (message RAG) - messages are chunked (5 at a time), embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 running locally'; :358 'No native external vector DB integration (lorebook uses local embeddings only).'
reality: packages/server/src/services/memory-recall.ts:113,170 uses the configured embeddingSource first and falls back to localEmbed (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) only when none is set. docs/connections/providers-reference.md:191-195: embeddings for lorebook semantic search and Memory Recall come from a connection's Embedding Model / Embedding Endpoint URL / Embedding Connection (OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Local Model sidecar). docs/lorebooks/semantic-search.md options 1-2 say the same; Lite builds hide the sidecar. The skill's own lorebooks.md:279 already describes this correctly.
fix: architecture.md:310: 'Memory Recall (Chat Settings -> Memory Recall) chunks messages 5 at a time and embeds them with the connection's Semantic Search (Embeddings) model or Embedding Connection (incl. Local Model sidecar), falling back to the built-in local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 when none is set; top 8 chunks above a similarity threshold.' architecture.md:358: 'No external vector DB integration - embeddings come from a connection's embedding model or the local fallback, stored in Marinara's own file store.'

title: TTS card still owns a Source/key that any Audio connection overrides
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:73 '...the Text to Speech card in Connections still holds voice assignment and playback settings'; :304 'Since v2.4.3 the backend is an Audio connection'
reality: packages/server/src/routes/tts.routes.ts:580-633 resolveAudioConfig: the explicitly requested Audio connection wins, then the Audio default, then the Audio fallback. Any of these overrides the TTS card's source, apiKey, baseUrl, voice and model. Only with no Audio connection at all does the legacy card config (its own Source / Base URL / API Key / Model fields, TTSConfigCard.tsx:1592-1680) decide. The card's Enable TTS master switch still gates default and fallback resolution ('an upgrade cannot silently re-enable TTS'). docs/media/tts-setup.md:5-50 and docs/conversation/calls.md:40-49 still tell users to enter Source and API key on the TTS card and never mention Audio connections (docs lag).
fix: Add to architecture.md:73: 'The Text to Speech card still has its own Source/Base URL/API Key/Model, but they apply only when no Audio connection exists - any default/fallback Audio connection overrides them - and the card's Enable TTS switch still gates speech. docs/media/tts-setup.md predates Audio connections; configure the backend under Connections -> Audio / Defaults -> Audio.'

title: Connected chats omit the <note> tag and one-to-one rules
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:313 'Connected chats - conversation <-> roleplay bidirectional links with <influence> (conversation -> RP) and <ooc> (RP -> conversation) tags.'
reality: docs/chats/connected-chats.md:9,41-63: links are one-to-one and created from the Conversation side (or from a Game via Link to Conversation; a Roleplay has no link button). The Conversation reads the story chat automatically. <influence> is a one-shot steer. <note> saves a durable fact that stays in the story chat's prompt every turn, listed under Conversation Notes with delete and Clear all. <ooc> lets a Roleplay character reply into the Conversation. Disconnect clears pending influences and notes. Roleplay also has an Allow character DMs toggle.

title: 2.5.0 robustness env vars missing from the 'added in 2.4.x-2.5.0' list
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:324 'Env vars added in 2.4.x-2.5.0 - MARINARA_MAX_RESIDENT_CHATS / MARINARA_EAGER_STORAGE; MARINARA_MEDIA_GENERATION_CONCURRENCY ...; PROVIDER_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED; MULTIPLAYER_ENABLED; LOREBOOK_STABLE_GROUP_WINNERS / PROVIDER_RETRY_TRANSIENT_ERRORS'
reality: docs/CONFIGURATION.md:367-380 (Robustness table, CHANGELOG line 518 in the 2.5.0 section) lists more opt-in vars, all off by default. STORAGE_YIELDING_SERIALIZE: saves of very long chats no longer stall other requests and streams. STORAGE_SKIP_UNCHANGED_WRITES. STORAGE_CACHE_WINDOWS_BOOT_ID (Windows; saves ~1.5-2 s per start). SHUTDOWN_WINDOWS_CONSOLE_SIGNALS, SHUTDOWN_FORCE_EXIT_ON_REPEAT, SHUTDOWN_EARLY_FLUSH, SHUTDOWN_RUNTIME_STOP_BUDGET_MS. CONFIGURATION.md:124 also documents MARINARA_ENV_WATCH=poll|0 for .env hot-reload on network mounts and containers.
fix: Append to architecture.md:324: 'Opt-in robustness knobs (v2.5.0, all off): STORAGE_YIELDING_SERIALIZE (long-chat saves stop stalling streams), STORAGE_SKIP_UNCHANGED_WRITES, STORAGE_CACHE_WINDOWS_BOOT_ID, SHUTDOWN_* (Windows console signals, force-exit, early flush, runtime stop budget); MARINARA_ENV_WATCH=poll when .env edits on a network/bind mount aren't picked up.'
